_readme: Single source of truth for the desktop shell's cross-language vocabulary. It holds the Tauri event names the Rust shell emits and the webview listens for. It holds the env vars Rust passes to the Go sidecar at spawn; the sidecar reads LEAPMUX_DESKTOP_DEV_ENDPOINT and LEAPMUX_DESKTOP_BINARY_HASH. It also holds the frame cap both programs enforce on the sidecar IPC wire. The cap must exceed channelwire.UserEventsReadLimit plus the Frame/Event envelope; frame_test.go's full-size-bootstrap test pins that floor. task generate-contracts emits a Rust module (desktop/rust/src/generated/contracts.rs), Go constants (the sidecar's main.go reads them), and the TS event names the webview subscribes with. The named-pipe and unix-socket endpoint NAMES are deliberately NOT here: only Rust constructs them, handing the endpoint to the Go sidecar through the env var. No second language spells them, so there is no mirror to hold. maxFrameSizeBytes rides the Go and Rust outputs only, like the env vars.
